system.description:
Price $50,000 · Concealment Touch · System Strain 2

Retractable nanofiber wings and integral boost jets allow a limited degree of flight. When leaping from a high place, the user gains a flight Move speed of 30m for up to two kilometers before being forced to land. Gaining altitude requires a Dex/Exert skill check against difficulty 10; failure forces a landing, and the wings can't carry the user more than twice as high as the height they jumped from. By deploying the boost jets and wings as an Instant action, the user can ignore up to a hundred meters of falling damage.
